verdict.rationale: MotherDuck supports headless/CI automation via CLI, Python SDKs, saved credentials for non-interactive sessions, and scheduled Python jobs for ingest/transformation; dbt integration and SaaS Mode further support scripted, non-interactive pipelines. Runtime probes confirm a keyless CLI roundtrip and a fully automatable MCP server flow, both consistent with CI usage. Missing for 10: an explicit CI/CD example (e.g., GitHub Actions workflow) or documented non-interactive auth token flow for pipelines.
